results: 2. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain
brain MRI: punctate FLAIR hyperintensities in the local white matter of both frontal lobes
3. Genetic testing panel for early-onset epileptic encephalopathies
genetic testing (exome / epilepsy panel): missense variant in exon 4 of CSNK2B (NM_001320.7 c.268A>C, p.Thr90Pro), likely pathogenic by ACMG; threonine 90 is evolutionarily conserved
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Poirier-Bienvenu neurodevelopmental syndrome (CSNK2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder)

1. Childhood absence epilepsy (though normal interictal EEG and abnormal development argue against typical CAE)
2. Other genetic epileptic encephalopathy (SCN1A, etc., though specific CSNK2B variant is likely pathogenic)
3. Non-epileptic movement disorder (tics, eyelid myoclonia without epilepsy)
